history.note: Deployment and current reads do not establish the unrecorded all-time PPS maximum

reasoning: Complete Strategy log history identifies only initial 1 USDC, one 4 USDC deposit and one 2 USDC withdrawal. No provider/entry changes or rebalances occurred; fee rates were initialized to zero and never changed.

Share mint/burn history reconstructs current supply exactly. Four other registered position tokens have no incoming/outgoing Transfer events over complete coverage, so held no shares. Aave aToken has exactly two incoming and one outgoing transfer matching the three economic operations.
Between those operations, both scaled aToken balance and Strategy share supply are fixed. Verified AToken balanceOf equals floor(scaledBalance*normalizedIncome/1e27).

Both verified Pool implementations use nonnegative linear interest; ReserveLogic only initializes a fresh reserve or updates its liquidity index by a factor >=RAY. The single Pool upgrade increases normalized income and leaves scaled balance unchanged. No aToken upgrade occurs.

Evaluate each fixed-balance interval using the normalized index at its closing operation/current snapshot. Floor token assets and ceil PPS explicitly; maximum of interval bounds is the current snapshot ceil PPS. This proof allows rounding dips at share-changing operations and makes no blanket monotonic-PPS assumption.

The result covers settled canonical economic states, excludes temporary intra-transaction pre-mint/burn states, and relies on complete canonical RPC logs plus verified protocol implementation source. Source identity provenance is closed separately by source-scope-closure.json. It is a data reconstruction rather than a governance signature.
